commands.final_qualification_script:
set -eu
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS=1
export PYTHONPATH=/home/ericgu/src/melee-sim-light:.
export MSL_CORE_LIBRARY=/home/ericgu/src/melee-sim-light/build/melee_core/python/libmelee_core.so
export HAL_O65_PROXY_CHECKPOINT=runs/proxy/final.pt HAL_O65_COMPILE_CUDA=1 HAL_REQUIRE_INTEGRATION=1
flock /home/ericgu/data/scratch/o65-tmp/gpu.lock systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=10G uv run --with zstandard pytest -q -ra tests/test_native_sim_integration.py -m integration --basetemp "$TMPDIR/native-replays-qualified" > runs/vectorize/native-replays-qualified.log 2>&1
flock /home/ericgu/data/scratch/o65-tmp/gpu.lock systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=10G uv run pytest -q -ra tests/test_roundtrip.py tests/test_session_cleanup.py -m integration --basetemp "$TMPDIR/roundtrip-final" > runs/vectorize/roundtrip-final.log 2>&1
flock /home/ericgu/data/scratch/o65-tmp/gpu.lock systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=10G uv run python experiments/065_selfplay_ppo.py train --checkpoint runs/proxy/final.pt --sampler experiments/o65/pilot-sampler.json --output runs/vectorize/final-resume-64 --data-dir /home/ericgu/src/melee-sim-light/data --cpus 0 1 2 3 --updates 4 --groups 4 --matches-per-shard 4 --compiled --max-frame 140 --training.critic-warmup-updates 0 --evaluation-every 0 --verify-resume > runs/vectorize/final-resume-64.log 2>&1
cp experiments/065_selfplay_ppo.py runs/vectorize/reviewed-source.py
export HAL_O65_CAPTURE_SOURCE=runs/vectorize/reviewed-source.py
for phase in ppo warmup; do
    for matches in 16 64; do
        if [ "$phase" = warmup ]; then
            flock /home/ericgu/data/scratch/o65-tmp/gpu.lock systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=10G uv run python tests/test_065_columnar.py --matches "$matches" --output "runs/vectorize/reviewed-$phase-$matches" --performance --fixed-anchor-lanes --warmup > "runs/vectorize/reviewed-$phase-$matches.log" 2>&1
        else
            flock /home/ericgu/data/scratch/o65-tmp/gpu.lock systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=10G uv run python tests/test_065_columnar.py --matches "$matches" --output "runs/vectorize/reviewed-$phase-$matches" --performance --fixed-anchor-lanes > "runs/vectorize/reviewed-$phase-$matches.log" 2>&1
        fi
    done
done
